usedFor: Robocorp runs automated processes, and Sangam CRM receives their output through “Create or Update Lead” after a “Process Run completed”.

bestTemplate.name: “Process Run completed” in Robocorp, then “Create or Update Lead” in Sangam CRM
bestTemplate.why: A finished run can hand its result to a lead matched by ID, email or phone.

watchOut: “Create or Update Lead” finds the lead by ID, email or phone, so the run must supply one.
